statement: The system shall allow prescribers to create a medication request that includes dosage instructions and dispense requests.
acceptance_criteria: Prescribers can create a new MedicationRequest with dosageInstruction and dispenseRequest elements, and the system stores it correctly.

statement: The system shall allow prescribers to specify the number of refills allowed for a medication request.
acceptance_criteria: Prescribers can set the numberOfRepeatsAllowed element in the dispenseRequest, and the system stores it correctly.

statement: The system shall allow prescribers to specify the quantity and duration of the initial fill for a medication request.
acceptance_criteria: Prescribers can set the initialFill.quantity and initialFill.duration elements in the dispenseRequest, and the system stores them correctly.

statement: The system shall allow prescribers to specify the minimum period of time between dispenses for a medication request.
acceptance_criteria: Prescribers can set the dispenseInterval element in the dispenseRequest, and the system stores it correctly.

statement: The system shall allow prescribers to specify the time period for which a medication request is authorized.
acceptance_criteria: Prescribers can set the validityPeriod element in the dispenseRequest, and the system stores it correctly.

statement: The system shall allow prescribers to specify the quantity of medication to supply per dispense in a medication request.
acceptance_criteria: Prescribers can set the quantity element in the dispenseRequest, and the system stores it correctly.

statement: The system shall allow prescribers to specify the expected number of days supply per dispense in a medication request.
acceptance_criteria: Prescribers can set the expectedSupplyDuration element in the dispenseRequest, and the system stores it correctly.

statement: The system shall allow prescribers to specify the intended dispenser for a medication request.
acceptance_criteria: Prescribers can set the performer element in the dispenseRequest, and the system stores it correctly.

statement: The system shall ensure that only authorized prescribers can create and modify medication requests.
acceptance_criteria: Only prescribers with valid credentials can create or modify MedicationRequests, and unauthorized attempts are rejected.

statement: The system shall ensure that medication requests are encrypted when stored locally on end-user devices.
acceptance_criteria: MedicationRequests are encrypted using the standard specified in § 170.210(a)(2) when stored locally on end-user devices.

statement: The system shall ensure that medication requests are protected from unauthorized access and modification.
acceptance_criteria: MedicationRequests are protected from unauthorized access and modification, and the audit log records any such attempts.

statement: The system shall ensure that medication requests are auditable for compliance and security purposes.
acceptance_criteria: MedicationRequests are recorded in the audit log, and the log can be reviewed to ensure compliance and security.

statement: The system shall ensure that medication requests are processed within 2 seconds for 95% of requests under a load of 50 concurrent prescribers.
acceptance_criteria: The system processes 95% of medication requests within 2 seconds when handling 50 concurrent prescribers.

statement: The system shall ensure that medication requests comply with regulatory requirements for prescription and refill management.
acceptance_criteria: MedicationRequests are created, modified, and transmitted in compliance with relevant regulations.

statement: The system shall ensure that medication requests are transmitted securely to the pharmacy.
acceptance_criteria: MedicationRequests are transmitted using a secure connection and encrypted data.

statement: The system shall ensure that medication requests are retained for at least 5 years as per regulatory requirements.
acceptance_criteria: MedicationRequests are retained in the system for at least 5 years.

statement: The system shall ensure that medication requests are protected from unauthorized disclosure.
acceptance_criteria: MedicationRequests are only accessible to authorized users and cannot be disclosed without proper authorization.

statement: The system shall ensure that medication requests are protected from tampering.
acceptance_criteria: MedicationRequests are protected from unauthorized modification and tampering, and any such attempts are detected and logged.
